description: Generic META baseline gameplan + macros for every user/CPU game. Opponent overlays stack on top as dynasty evidence accumulates; thin opponents stay near baseline.

offense_gameplan.two_high_rule: Run first vs Cover 4 / Cover 6 / Cover 9 / Quarters / Palms. Prefer Inside Zone, HB Base, Counter Y from Gun Bunch X Nasty before forcing Mesh Post or Deep Flood.

pressure_answers.label: Mesh Spot (quick)
pressure_answers.note: Primary pressure answer — easy completion under heat

pressure_answers.label: Whip Trail
pressure_answers.note: Secondary pressure / man answer — whip then trail

pressure_answers.label: HB Base protection
pressure_answers.note: When pressure is selling out — run behind protection

red_zone.note: Tag by coverage — C2 Invert Hard Flat ≠ always whip (film INTs). Prefer Mesh Spot / Z Spot Shake / run.

offense_gameplan.anti_repeat: Never become 80% one concept vs sticky opponent. Track last calls in-game; if same play called 2+ times in last 4 snaps, rotate to constraint family (run↔easy pass↔Cluster changeup).

short_yardage.note: Even 6-1 only true short; no auto RUN-IN on one IZ tell

goal_line.note: Heavy front; don't sell out run (Temple Z Smash lesson)

money_down.note: Patience — Cover 6/two-high patience applies to us too

selective_pressure.when: 3rd-and-short with repeated pressure-worthy tendency OR high-confidence opponent archetype
selective_pressure.note: Selective — not every snap. One user job on hot.

reasons.CROSS: META keep — answers Cross Wheels / high-low crossers after repeated tendency
reasons.VERT: META keep — answers Four Verticals / seam stress after repeated tendency
reasons.BUNCH: META keep — answers compressed Mesh/Bunch rubs after repeated wins
reasons.RPO: META keep — answers bubble/RPO alert tendency
reasons.SCRAM: META keep — contain integrity when QB escape beats coverage carry
reasons.RUN-IN: META keep — downhill IZ/Duo sellout only at high confidence + short
reasons.RUN-OUT: META keep — perimeter stretch/toss when repeated
reasons.HEAT: META keep — selective pressure package tag, not every snap
reasons.FLOOD: BENCH — flood/levels not primary META answer; reactivate only if opponent makes flood primary AND online stability re-tested
reasons.SCREEN: BENCH — screen/bubble specialty; Temple playtest kept 0 O macros + SCREEN off D; reactivate only if bubbles dominate after re-test

macros_baseline.arm_doctrine: Macros situational, not every snap. Default = no macro. Arm only after REPEATED tendency in similar D&D/field zone. One tell = log + mild bump only. Free reign preserved — any designed call remains legal.

when_to_arm.CROSS: After 2+ live Cross Wheels / crosser tells in similar D&D
when_to_arm.VERT: After 2+ live Four Verticals / seam tells in similar D&D
when_to_arm.RPO: After repeated RPO bubble / alert wins
when_to_arm.SCRAM: After repeated QB scramble escapes beat coverage
when_to_arm.RUN-IN: After repeated downhill run AND short-yardage context — never one IZ tell
when_to_arm.RUN-OUT: After repeated Outside Zone / Stretch / toss
when_to_arm.HEAT: 3rd-short selective vs pressure-worthy archetype or repeated money-down need

meta_notes: Bunch / Mesh families are the META core — Gun Bunch X Nasty primary, Gun Cluster counterpunch. Preserve both.
Constraint theory: run to set up play-action; verticals to open underneath; underneath to set up shots. Do not spam one family.
Cover 6 / split-field patience: vs two-high, run first and take easy Mesh Spot. Do NOT spam Mesh Post into Cover 6 (INT film).
Defense: Nickel Over home (C3 Sky / C4 Quarters / Tampa 2). Force long drives; explosives kill you more than dinks.
Soft competitive meta only — Xbox formation/play/macro NAMES. No invented PlayStation or Xbox button sequences.
Every game starts from this baseline. Opponent overlays adjust mix rates and macro emphasis as snaps accumulate; thin film stays near baseline.
